Please show past work that proves you have already designed main images for Amazon listings; seeing before-and-after examples from live listings will help me choose quickly. Deliverables • 1 finished main image banner in JPG (ready to upload) • The editable source file (PSD or AI) with organized layers I will supply high-resolution product photo

Both should carry the same natural, rural aesthetic—think warm earth tones, textured backgrounds that feel like paper or wood, and imagery that makes the reader breathe a little deeper. The brochure will be the main storyteller. It has to spotlight our lush greenery, tree-lined walkways, and the feeling of peaceful living that families and organic-farming enthusiasts crave. Make room as well for a concise map and copy that calls out nearby facilities; accessibility is a major sell

Recruit farm workers for the venture
